Named factories remove the 6-arg result bag while classify() preserves probe semantics (2xx passthrough, 401+CreditsError discrimination, 429); verified() docblock now precisely documents 2xx passthrough vs legacy default-200, resolving the prior note.

PREFIX const alias and transientKeys()/allTransientKeys() wrappers removed; probe, readCachedResult, and persistResult reference Catalog::AVAIL_PREFIX directly, eliminating the fork risk from the prior note.
Bust hook stays credential-blind (transient deletes only, hook names alone reference connectors_ai_* keys) and separate Go/Zen setting names remain untouched.

Merged single endpoint check preserves the same endpoint_mismatch rejection reason while select() orchestration (validatePrimary/evaluateCandidate, MAX_CANDIDATES bound, cycle detection) keeps fallback semantics.
